# Hatch — full component catalog

Install: pnpm add @pritish.budhiraja/ui
Styles: import "@pritish.budhiraja/ui/styles.css"
Motion: import { OriginButton, ScrollProgress } from "@pritish.budhiraja/ui/motion"
Theme: data-theme="portfolio"; class="dark"
Docs: https://ui.pritishbudhiraja.com

## Signature

- OriginButton — Primary CTA with pointer-origin ripple. Import from /motion. Not for every toolbar control. vs Button.
- FramedContainer — Page chrome: dashed column + gutters. vs Surface for inner panels.
- HatchDivider — Hatched section rule. vs Separator in dense chrome.
- EditorialAnnotation — Handwritten margin note. vs Alert for operational messages.
- CalendarHeatmap — Year activity grid with text summary. vs DatePicker.
- ThemeToggle — Controlled light/dark with circular view transition. Host owns storage.
- ScrollProgress — Fixed reading bar. Import from /motion.
- Surface — Dashed inner panel. vs Card for header/title/footer.

## Actions

- Button — Quiet default/outline/ghost. vs OriginButton for signature CTAs.
- IconButton — Icon-only; requires label.
- LinkButton — Text-style link action.
- LoadingButton — Submit in flight.
- CopyButton — Copy value with clipboard feedback.

## Forms

- Input, Textarea, Label, Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup
- Select — Known list. vs Combobox when searchable.
- Combobox, Slider, FormField, SearchInput, DatePicker, TimePicker, FilterBar

## Overlays and feedback

- Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet (Drawer alias), Popover, Tooltip
- DropdownMenu, ContextMenu
- CommandPalette — Pass items from the host. ⌘K.
- Toast — Mount Toaster once. vs Alert for inline status.
- EmptyState, ErrorState, Skeleton, Spinner, ProgressBar

## Navigation

- Tabs, Accordion, Breadcrumb, Pagination
- Navbar — Shell only. Hosts own Next Link and brand.
- Sidebar, AppShell, KeyboardShortcut

## Data and type

- Text, Heading (EditorialHeading for serif display)
- Badge, Avatar, Card, Table, DataTable, Timeline, ActivityTimeline, StatCard, DescriptionList
- Stack, Grid, Separator
- DateRangePicker, DurationPicker, TimeRangePicker
- WeekCalendar, TimeGrid, CalendarEvent, SortableList (calendar is presentational; host persists)
- SplitWorkspace, ResizablePanel, CollapsibleSidebar, InspectorPanel
- CodeBlock, MarkdownRenderer (GFM; images opt-in https), RichTextEditor, StreamingText
- AIExecutionStatus, WorkflowStepper, MilestoneStepper
- TimeAllocationBar, WeeklyActivityGrid, CountdownDisplay, FileDropzone, VirtualList
- Charts via @pritish.budhiraja/ui/charts: StackedBarChart, AreaChart, DonutChart

## Hooks

cn, useClipboard, useReducedMotion, useToast, useKeyboardShortcut, useMediaQuery, useDebounce, useControlledState, useClickOutside

## Do not

- next/link, next/navigation, next/font inside library components
- Epoch SeasonCard, FocusTimer, TaskRow
- Hardcode product colors
